Method of Attack: Waits until user opens banking or social media app, then shows HTML-based overlay to phish credentials
Collects user credentials and sends to C&C server
Uses stolen credentials for fraudulent transactions or social media spam
Collects contact lists from infected devices
Takes over SMS function to bypass two-factor authentication and suppress notifications
Blocks incoming phone calls from numbers associated with banks and financial institutions
Planned SOCKS and VNC modules for remote control (RAT-like features)
Impacted Systems: Android smartphones running versions up to 6.0 (Marshmallow)
Indicators of Compromise: C&C servers used to manage the trojan
HTML overlays for over 60 banking and social media apps
